description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractCryptoClient` in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing a base for cryptographic clients that handle encryption and decryption workflows. It includes static properties for supported cipher types and key wrapping methods, and abstract methods for obtaining cipher-specific details and performing encryption/decryption streams.

classes.name: AbstractCryptoClient
classes.description: An abstract base class for AWS cryptographic clients, handling supported cipher configurations and defining interface methods for encryption and decryption.

methods.name: isSupportedCipher
methods.description: Checks if a given cipher name is supported by the SDK.
